claim.quote: We discuss several possible causes for an irreducible excess of bulk-like events below 3 keVee, including a dark matter candidate common to the DAMA/LIBRA annual modulation effect, the hint of a signal in CDMS, and phenomenological predictions.

name: Results from a Search for Light-Mass Dark Matter with a P-type Point Contact Germanium Detector
notes: Recorded as an anomaly: the abstract speaks of 'an irreducible excess' and lists possible causes; it does not claim a detection.

summary.plain: CoGeNT's germanium crystal in the Soudan mine recorded more low-energy events than its known backgrounds explained. The authors listed possible causes, including light dark matter, without claiming a discovery.
summary.technical: Ultra-low-noise p-type point-contact germanium detector at 2,100 m.w.e. (Soudan); a surface-event rejection technique lets cosmogenic peaks be seen for the first time; irreducible excess of bulk-like events below 3 keVee; improved constraints on a cosmological origin of the DAMA/LIBRA effect.

title: Results from a Search for Light-Mass Dark Matter with a P-type Point Contact Germanium Detector
why_it_matters: The paper that put CoGeNT's low-mass excess on the map; it motivated many light-WIMP interpretations and the follow-up modulation analyses.
